title: Announcing OFUX – Our Brand New 3‑in‑1 Audit Dashboard
excerpt: We’ve rebuilt the Traffic Torch homepage from the ground up. Meet OFUX: a unified dashboard that scores UX Health, SEO Intent, and AI Search in one click – with zero fluff and total privacy.
content:
O FUX – The OFUX Dashboard Is Live

We’re excited to unveil the biggest upgrade to the Traffic Torch homepage since we launched: the OFUX Dashboard.

OFUX stands for Online Findability & User Experience. It combines three independent audits – UX Health, SEO Intent, and AI Search – into a single, clean dashboard. And yes, we’ve given it the tagline “Zero FUX” because we’ve stripped away all the kerfuffles you usually find in SEO tools.

What’s new?

Previously, we had a basic SEO tool that did a decent job but only scratched the surface. We knew we could do better. So we rebuilt everything from the ground up. Now, when you enter a URL, you get:

  • A UX Health score that checks readability, navigation, accessibility, mobile readiness, and performance proxies.
  • An SEO Intent score that measures E‑E‑A‑T signals, content depth, schema markup, and intent alignment.
  • An AI Search (AEO) score that evaluates answerability, structured data, scannability, conversational tone, originality, and anti‑AI safety.

All three scores are shown side‑by‑side, so you can see at a glance where your page stands. If you need more detail, each card has a “Full Results” button that takes you to the standalone tool for a deep dive.

AI‑generated CMS fixer (beta)

We also added an AI‑generated CMS fixer (beta). After the audit, you can click “Generate AI Fixes” and we’ll detect your CMS (WordPress, Shopify, Wix, etc.) and give you three specific, actionable recommendations – without inventing fake menu paths.

We ran a self‑audit on our own site and saw our overall score improve from around 70 to over 80 after applying the fixes. We’re confident this tool will help you find and fix issues that are holding your site back.

Privacy‑first, always

The best part? Everything runs in your browser. We don’t store or log any data – it’s completely privacy‑first.

Try it out at https://traffictorch.net/ – we’d love to hear your feedback. And as always, zero fux given.

title: Two New Tools & Full Dashboard Upgrade – Lighthouse Plus + AEO Performance (Beta Discounts Inside)
excerpt: Traffic Torch just launched two new audit tools: Lighthouse Plus and AEO Performance. Plus a full dashboard upgrade and generous beta discount codes for Pro Lifetime and Enterprise.
content:
Two New Tools, One Big Dashboard Upgrade

We’ve been busy. Traffic Torch now has two brand-new audit tools, a fully upgraded dashboard, and beta pricing that’s almost too generous to believe.

The new tools are Lighthouse Plus and AEO Performance. Both are live now and ready to audit your pages from the dashboard or as standalone tools.

🔦 Lighthouse Plus Tool

Lighthouse Plus goes beyond a standard Lighthouse run. It scores ten weighted modules, including Core Web Vitals, Performance Score, Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO On-Page, PWA Readiness, Resource Optimisation, Third-Party Impact, Mobile UX, and Agentic Browsing.

You get an overall score, a radar chart, module cards, priority fixes, and live browser metrics from Puppeteer + Browser Run. There’s also CMS-specific fix generation, an AI Q&A panel, and a shareable dashboard. It’s built for anyone who wants the full picture without jumping between five tabs.

Try Lighthouse Plus →

🤖 AEO Performance Tool

AEO Performance focuses on Answer Engine Optimisation – how well your content is structured for AI search, answer engines, and conversational discovery. It checks the signals that matter for modern search: answerability, structured data, scannability, render fidelity, and more.

Like Lighthouse Plus, it includes module scores, a radar chart, priority fixes, live browser metrics, CMS detection, AI-powered fix generation, and an Ask AI panel. If you care about being found by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and the next wave of search, this is your tool.

Try AEO Performance →

📊 Fully Upgraded Dashboard

The dashboard has been rebuilt to bring everything together. You can run audits, compare module scores, see pass/warning/fail counts, generate CMS fixes, ask the AI follow-up questions, and share results – all from one place. It also shows your plan, daily limits, and beta offers.

Every plan includes all 15 tools, but Pro and Enterprise unlock higher daily audit limits, longer data retention, CSV exports, priority support, and more. See the full comparison on the pricing page.

🎉 Beta Discounts – Grab Them While They Last

We’re in beta, and we’re celebrating with two generous offers:

  • Pro Lifetime – $0 (normally $198)
    Use code traffictorchpro at registration.
  • Enterprise – 29% off
    Use code TRAFFICTORCH at checkout. That’s $48/mo or $480/yr instead of $68/mo or $680/yr.

These are beta-period offers, so don’t wait too long. As always, limits reset at midnight UTC, and you can manage your plan from your dashboard.

Privacy-First, Always

We built Traffic Torch to be privacy-first. Your audits are designed to run with minimal data exposure, and we don’t sell your data. Ever.

Ready to see where you stand? Run a free audit on traffictorch.net, try the new tools, and tell us what you think. Zero fux given – just better search results.
